description:
About the Organization
Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. We are a solution-driven company delivering data insights and technology solutions to customers with missions critical to U.S. national interests. We’re looking for thoughtful, skilled professionals who thrive as trusted partners building technology-agnostic solutions and want to apply their talents supporting customers with difficult and important mission sets.


About the Role
Redhorse is hiring a Full Stack Developer with an active TS/SCI clearance to join our growing team making an operational impact with ISR data in the Defense Intelligence Enterprise. The developer will interface with the client, stakeholders, military personnel, and data providers to ensure that the ISR Analysis Team within the OUSD(I&S) has maximal buy-in for its activities and can identify and collect the data it needs. Additionally, this high-performing contractor will also maintain and develop the client's rapidly expanding tool for ISR data aggregation, linking, and analysis.  The ideal candidate will provide support in the areas of application development, automated extract/transform/load operations, database operations, front-end & back-end design, and data visualization. The individual will compose solutions that rapidly deliver functionality to enrich and visualize vast amounts of structured and unstructured data from various sources and formats. The work location for this role is Reston, VA.

Experience/Clearance

 Active TOP SECRET (TS) with Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) access, required. Individuals who do not have an active TS clearance with SCI access will not be considered for this opportunity.

 Bachelor' s Degree in Computer Science or Engineering or similar technical degree

 Strong experience programming in Python and other Object-Oriented Languages producing clean, reusable, and modular code.

 5+ years of experience with software design, implementation, testing, and deployment.

 Experience with CentOS or other flavors of Linux, Docker, Ansible, Cron tasks, PuTTy and other software for use on DevSecOps tasks.

 ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) development, including merging and normalizing related data sources.

 Experience with asynchronous code running in a queuing system such as a Redis Queue.

 Experience with legacy web service APIs such as SOAP as well as text-based and web-based data scraping.

 Ability to troubleshoot application networking, routing, client certificates and errors.

 Ability to work in a small, innovative and agile team environment, including on government site where availability of advanced development/database tools may be limited.


Desired Experience
 

 Experience building new products and services from the ground up.

 Strong Python experience

 Experience with building RESTful APIs

 Experience with NoSQL databases, preferably MongoDB

 Intermediate to advanced knowledge of computer networking and information security
